notes: Use an Opal or contactless card on ferries, trains and buses; the Sunday fare cap is cheap. The airport train takes 20 minutes (surcharge ~17 AUD).
NOTE: June to September is WINTER in Sydney (12-18°C, rain possible); beaches are good for walking, it is whale season and the crowds are thinner.
Coffee culture: a flat white costs 5 AUD, brunch 25-30; fish and chips 20, restaurants 40+. Tipping is not expected.
Swim between the flags at beaches (rip currents); the Bondi to Coogee walk is cool in the morning.
Book the Opera House tour and BridgeClimb online; Taronga offers a combined ferry and entry ticket.
The train from Central to the Blue Mountains takes 2 hours; Scenic World tickets are discounted online.

stops.name: Sydney Opera House
stops.tips: Take the 1-hour interior tour (~45 AUD) or admire it from outside; Bennelong Point has lovely morning light.

stops.name: Royal Botanic Garden Sydney
stops.tips: Harbourside gardens; Mrs Macquarie's Chair frames the Opera House and the bridge.

stops.name: The Rocks
stops.tips: Colonial-era stone lanes; weekend market and Cadmans Cottage.

stops.name: The Rocks Cafe
stops.tips: Breakfast or lunch in the Rocks; try the Australian breakfast.

stops.name: Sydney Harbour Bridge Pylon Lookout
stops.tips: 200 steps up the bridge's south-east pylon; a cheap alternative to BridgeClimb (300+ AUD), then walk across the bridge.

backups.name: Opera Bar
backups.tips: Harbourside bar beneath the Opera House; great at sunset.

backups.name: Museum of Contemporary Art Australia
backups.tips: Free museum at Circular Quay; rooftop cafe.

stops.name: Bondi Beach
stops.tips: Australia's most famous beach; surfers in the morning, Icebergs pool (9 AUD), sea around 22°C in summer.

stops.name: Bondi to Coogee Coastal Walk
stops.tips: 6 km of rocky clifftop path past Tamarama, Bronte, Waverley Cemetery and Clovelly.

stops.name: Coogee Pavilion
stops.tips: Rooftop bar and restaurant on Coogee Beach; pizza and seafood.

stops.name: Coogee Beach
stops.tips: Calm cove with the Wylie's Baths rock pool.

stops.name: Bondi Icebergs Sunset
stops.tips: Views of the famous rock pool and the beach; return by bus.

backups.name: Bills Bondi
backups.tips: Ricotta hotcakes; the Bondi brunch classic.

backups.name: Bronte Baths
backups.tips: Rock pool at Bronte; an alternative to Coogee.

stops.name: Manly Ferry Circular Quay
stops.tips: 30-minute ferry ride, "the world's best 8 dollar harbour cruise"; pay with Opal.

stops.name: Manly Beach
stops.tips: Surf beach lined with Norfolk pines; stroll along The Corso.

stops.name: Manly to Spit Bridge Walk
stops.tips: 10 km harbourside walk past Aboriginal rock carvings and coves (short version: Shelly Beach, 1 km).

stops.name: Manly Wharf Hotel
stops.tips: Wharfside pub; fish and beer with harbour views.

stops.name: Manly Ferry Sunset Return
stops.tips: On the ferry heading west, watch the sun set over the Opera House and the bridge.

backups.name: Shelly Beach Manly
backups.tips: Snorkelling cove; a shorter option than the long walk.

backups.name: Hugos Manly
backups.tips: Pizza and seafood on the wharf.

stops.name: Echo Point Three Sisters
stops.tips: 2 hours by train (Katoomba); free views of the Three Sisters rock formation and the valley.

stops.name: Scenic World Katoomba
stops.tips: The world's steepest railway, a cableway and a rainforest boardwalk (~55 AUD).

stops.name: Katoomba Yellow Deli
stops.tips: Wood-panelled cafe in Katoomba; sandwiches and soup.

stops.name: Wentworth Falls Walk
stops.tips: Waterfall and clifftop trail (short section of the National Pass); start from the train station.

stops.name: Leura Village
stops.tips: Pretty town with cherry trees and antique shops; take the train back.

backups.name: Leura Garage
backups.tips: Restaurant in a former garage in Leura.

backups.name: Jenolan Caves
backups.tips: Limestone caves; an alternative to Wentworth Falls (by car).

stops.name: Taronga Zoo Sydney
stops.tips: 12 minutes by ferry; koalas and kangaroos, plus a cable car with harbour views.

stops.name: Taronga Zoo Ferry Wharf
stops.tips: Take the ferry to Darling Harbour or Circular Quay.

stops.name: Darling Harbour
stops.tips: Waterfront stroll and Pyrmont Bridge.

stops.name: Sydney Fish Market
stops.tips: The Southern Hemisphere's largest fish market; sashimi and oysters straight from the counter, in a new building.

stops.name: Barangaroo Reserve
stops.tips: Harbourside park; sunset and the Wulugul Walk.

backups.name: SEA LIFE Sydney Aquarium
backups.tips: Aquarium at Darling Harbour; an alternative to the zoo.

backups.name: Chinatown Sydney Dixon Street
backups.tips: Dim sum and Chinatown; an alternative to the fish market.

stops.name: Surry Hills Crown Street
stops.tips: Cafes and boutiques; Bourke Street Bakery.

stops.name: Bourke Street Bakery
stops.tips: Sydney's famous bakery; try the ginger brûlée tart and sausage roll.

stops.name: Paddington Reservoir Gardens
stops.tips: Sunken gardens in a former water reservoir; Oxford Street is close by.

stops.name: Paddington Markets
stops.tips: Saturday market (on other days, browse the boutiques on Oxford Street).

stops.name: Newtown King Street
stops.tips: Street art, vegan cafes and vintage shops; Enmore Theatre.

backups.name: Mary's Newtown
backups.tips: Burgers and fried chicken in Newtown.

backups.name: Brett Whiteley Studio
backups.tips: Painter's studio in Surry Hills (weekends only); an alternative to the reservoir.

stops.name: Watsons Bay Ferry
stops.tips: 30 minutes from Circular Quay; towards the harbour entrance.

stops.name: The Gap Lookout
stops.tips: Ocean cliffs; whale watching (May to November).

stops.name: Camp Cove Beach
stops.tips: Calm harbour beach; good for swimming in summer.

stops.name: Doyles on the Beach Watsons Bay
stops.tips: Seafood restaurant since 1885; a farewell lunch with views of the Opera House.

stops.name: Circular Quay Airport Train
stops.tips: The airport train takes 20 minutes; time to say goodbye.

backups.name: Watsons Bay Boutique Hotel
backups.tips: Beer garden and fish and chips.

backups.name: South Head Heritage Trail
backups.tips: Walk to Hornby Lighthouse; an alternative to the beach.
